facts.fact: Co-Develop says FinMark Trust's pilot between Lesotho and South Africa demonstrated real-time cross-border identity verification, with Lesotho migrants accessing formal remittance services in South Africa using their national digital IDs.
facts.system: FinMark Trust Lesotho-South Africa cross-border identity verification pilot

systems.system: FinMark Trust Lesotho-South Africa cross-border identity verification pilot

note: as_of is the document's published date; it gives no pilot date. The 16-state SADC eKYC ecosystem does not name Lesotho as a participant, so no fact is taken from it.
